name: 004-pika-frames-demo
title: 《雨停之前》
style: Photorealistic live-action romantic film still, 16:9 widescreen, realistic human anatomy and skin texture, soft natural depth of field, 35mm or 50mm cinema lens, cool blue-gray rainy exteriors, subtle amber window lights, realistic grain, restrained mood
female: Lin Xia, 21-year-old East Asian university student, neat jaw-length straight black bob, SILVER CRESCENT hairclip on the LEFT, pale-blue knit cardigan over ivory blouse, charcoal pleated skirt, slim dark shoulder bag, and a DARK NAVY hardcover notebook
male: Chen Yu, 22-year-old East Asian university student, short softly wavy black hair, FOREST-GREEN varsity jacket over white crew-neck T-shirt, dark trousers, ONE transparent umbrella with a curved white handle
avoid: No captions, writing, subtitles, watermarks, logos, collage, extra umbrella, scarf, hoodie, backpack, phone, duplicate limbs, hairstyle drift or outfit changes

shots.title: 笔记本落地
shots.location: Rainy university stone arcade; fixed medium-wide, ivy-covered pillar left, wet courtyard right
shots.first: Lin waits at LEFT pillar looking down at her closed navy notebook on the wet ground. Chen enters far RIGHT under his ONE OPEN clear umbrella
shots.last: Same frame: Chen has walked closer and bends to pick up the same navy notebook with his free hand. Lin stays at the pillar, watching. Umbrella remains OPEN
shots.motion: Chen steps nearer, bends and retrieves the notebook; Lin lifts her gaze. Tiny slow camera push-in
shots.soundscape: Heavy rain on stones, one shoe splash and shifting fabric
shots.music: Three sparse felt-piano notes over low sustained cello

shots.title: 同一把伞
shots.location: Same stone arcade and window as 001, fixed 50mm medium two-shot, Lin LEFT and Chen RIGHT
shots.first: Chen extends the navy notebook toward Lin; Lin extends her hand. Chen's OPEN transparent umbrella covers only Chen
shots.last: Same frame: Lin hugs the notebook to her chest, steps half a pace closer, and the same OPEN clear umbrella is now centered above BOTH; two small smiles
shots.motion: Lin receives the notebook while Chen slowly tips the canopy to shelter them both, followed by restrained eye contact
shots.soundscape: Rain pattering on the clear umbrella, book cover brushing her cardigan
shots.music: Soft piano chords with a thin sustained viola

shots.title: 伞偏向她
shots.location: Same rainy tree-lined campus path with wet stones and lampposts; slow 50mm side tracking, Lin LEFT Chen RIGHT
shots.first: Both walk under one OPEN clear umbrella angled toward Lin; Chen's outer right shoulder is wet. He holds handle in RIGHT hand; Lin holds navy notebook in LEFT arm
shots.last: Same tracking perspective: Lin's RIGHT hand touches Chen's on umbrella shaft, nudging canopy toward the middle. Their shoulders are sheltered evenly; notebook still in LEFT arm
shots.motion: They take two slow steps. Lin notices his damp shoulder and gently centers the umbrella by touching the shaft; subtle side tracking
shots.soundscape: Wet footsteps, light rain on canopy, a distant bicycle bell
shots.music: A gentle four-note piano arpeggio with quiet viola

shots.title: 图书馆空位
shots.location: Warm university library, SAME pale-oak table, rainy window, amber reading lamp; static 35mm medium-wide shot
shots.first: Lin sits LEFT at table, navy notebook in front of her; Chen stands RIGHT behind an EMPTY oak chair. The SINGLE clear umbrella is CLOSED and leans on RIGHT table leg
shots.last: Same camera and room: Chen now sits in the RIGHT chair facing Lin, both smiling faintly; notebook and CLOSED umbrella remain in EXACTLY same positions
shots.motion: Chen slides out chair and sits; Lin offers a small inviting gesture; camera holds still
shots.soundscape: Soft chair scrape, distant turning pages and rain on windows
shots.music: Warm quiet piano chords and soft cello

shots.title: 纸上小伞
shots.location: EXACT SAME library oak table and rainy window as 004; 50mm seated two-shot including hands and faces
shots.first: Chen on RIGHT draws a simple umbrella pictogram on an off-white note with black pencil; Lin watches from LEFT. Navy notebook stays closed by her left hand. No words
shots.last: Same camera: Lin's RIGHT hand holds note with the SAME single umbrella pictogram above the notebook, she smiles; Chen sets pencil down. No added objects or text
shots.motion: Chen completes pencil line, sets pencil down, slides note; Lin lifts it and smiles naturally
shots.soundscape: Pencil on paper, note sliding on oak, soft little laugh
shots.music: Light piano upper notes answered by short strings

shots.title: 雨停以后
shots.location: Blue-hour path outside university library, rain STOPPED, wet reflective stones, amber lamps; static rear three-quarter 35mm medium-wide shot
shots.first: Lin walks LEFT, navy notebook in LEFT arm. Chen walks RIGHT, CLOSED clear umbrella in RIGHT hand. Their adjacent hands—her RIGHT and his LEFT—are separated
shots.last: Same perspective and path: Lin's RIGHT hand and Chen's LEFT hand have interlaced, both walking slightly farther from camera. Notebook and CLOSED umbrella unchanged
shots.motion: They walk two slow steps; Lin reaches across with right hand, Chen joins with left, slight camera pull-back, no cut
shots.soundscape: Paired footsteps on damp stone, occasional drops from leaves
shots.music: Short resolving piano phrase over sustained warm strings
